restriction: Completed R4 core and matched five-candidate experiment only; PROFILE remains reserved. No IQ/solver/GPU.

formal_geometry.caption_zh: 20个正式源站布局。面板内相同形状表示同一对源，红色为A、蓝色为B；数字为布局编号。
formal_geometry.caption_en: All 20 geometries. Matching shapes within each panel identify a pair; red: A, blue: B.
formal_geometry.selection: All preregistered layouts; no connecting lines.

formal_core.caption_zh: 2400条核心观测的功率差扫描，每档400条。
formal_core.caption_en: Core power-gap scan: 400 observations per gap, 2400 in total.

formal_common.caption_zh: 共同240条观测上的方法比较，每档40条。
formal_common.caption_en: Method comparison on exactly the same 240 observations, 40 per gap.
formal_common.selection: Fixed common subset: realizations 400/410 in every layout.

formal_cdf_cost.caption_zh: 左为核心2400条的误差CDF，右为共同240条的可靠性—完整耗时。
formal_cdf_cost.caption_en: Left: core error CDF (n=2400); right: common-subset reliability versus complete runtime (n=240).
formal_cdf_cost.selection: Panels use separate, labeled sample scopes; no cross-scope ranking.

formal_layouts.caption_zh: 各布局未达到双源20m门槛的观测数，每布局120条；零表示全部成功。
formal_layouts.caption_en: Failures per geometry (120 observations each); zero indicates complete success.
formal_layouts.selection: All 20 geometries; same source data as the earlier heatmap.

formal_ablation.caption_zh: 候选数与精修方式对可靠性、耗时和梯度计算的影响。
formal_ablation.caption_en: Candidate retention above; matched five-candidate refinement costs below.
formal_ablation.selection: Top: original 2400 core observations. Bottom: 2400 new matched pairs on the same inputs; no cross-run speed ratio.

formal_time.caption_zh: 共同240条观测的已保存输出轨迹，横轴均为线性；上行为全时段，下行为前三秒。
formal_time.caption_en: Saved-output replay on 240 observations with linear time axes: full range above, first three seconds below.
formal_time.selection: Fixed time checkpoints, latest available output, no oracle selection or new early-stopping program.

formal_candidates.caption_zh: 同一困难构型的两个0dB案例：单源谱、条件谱及精修前后候选残差；上行恢复，下行未恢复。
formal_candidates.caption_en: Two equal-power post-hoc cases: single-source/conditional spectra and branch residuals; recovered above, not recovered below.
formal_candidates.selection: Post-hoc geometry 3, realizations 400/405, 0 dB; A/B labels at equal received powers. Arrows/paths not inferred.
